key_insight: RECONTEXT improves long-context reasoning by recursively selecting and replaying the most relevant evidence from the original context before final generation, without training or pruning.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical, training-free way to boost evidence use in long-context LLM applications where large context windows alone do not guarantee correct reasoning.
method: Build a query-conditioned evidence pool using model-internal relevance signals.
Replay the selected evidence before answer generation while preserving the full original context.
Separate evidence organization from generation, with no external memory or additional training.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on eight long-context datasets at 128K context length, RECONTEXT improved evidence utilization across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama3-8B and achieved the best average rank on all three backbones.
watch_item: The approach depends on the quality of model-internal relevance signals, so weak signal extraction could limit gains or add inference overhead.
paper_title: ReContext: Recursive Evidence Replay as LLM Harness for Long-Context Reasoning
